name: transfer_call
description: Transfer the caller to a hotel DEPARTMENT - the restaurant, the duty manager, or housekeeping. NOT a guest's room (never connect a caller to a guest). Before calling this you must have told the caller you're putting them on hold to connect them to that department AND gotten their okay; only then transfer. Pass a one-line summary of what the caller needs so the department is briefed.

summary.description: A one-line summary of what the caller needs.
summary.title: Summary
